title: Basic consequences of properness
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a
proper morphism of schemes.
Then $f$ is separated, universally closed, of finite type,
quasi-compact and quasi-separated. In
particular, if $S$ is affine then $X$ is separated and quasi-compact.

proof.text: Use Mathlib IsProper parent instances [def-weil-proper-morphism] to obtain IsSeparated, UniversallyClosed and LocallyOfFiniteType. The UniversallyClosed instance yields QuasiCompact, giving finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Infer QuasiSeparated from IsSeparated [lem-pc-separated-quasi-separated]. For affine S, install IsAffine S as a local instance. HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine for IsSeparated.hasAffineProperty yields X.IsSeparated [lem-sc-separated-over-affine-scheme-separated]. Affine S has CompactSpace S, so QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f gives CompactSpace X. Assemble these conclusions as the stated conjunction.
